runs.method: Updated guide with 'Cardinal Rule: Never Fabricate Text' section

runs.method: Three-agent workflow: alphabet builder → transcriber → evaluator

runs.method: Formalized alphabet-first with written instructions, all 5 manuscripts, isolated environment

runs.method: 'Read Letters Not Words' principle + separate review agent for flagged passages

runs.method: Three independent transcription agents merged by fourth reconciliation agent using majority rule (EMROC-style)
